units.source_text: 到了除日傍晚，源氏公子把别人送他的衣服一套，

en.t: On the evening of New Year's Eve, Prince Genji took a set of robes that someone else had given him,

units.source_text: 再加淡紫色花绫衫子一件，以及棣棠色衫子等种种衣服，

en.t: added a pale purple figured-silk robe, a robe the color of kerria blossoms, and various other garments,

units.source_text: 装在前日小姐送来的衣箱里，教大辅命妇拿去送给她。

en.t: packed them in the clothes chest the lady had sent the other day, and told Dainagon no Myobu to take them to her as a gift.

units.source_text: 命妇看了这些衣服，推想公子不喜爱小姐送他的衣服的颜色。

en.t: When Myobu saw these robes, she guessed that the prince had not liked the color of the garments the lady had sent him.

units.source_text: 但那些年老的侍女却在那里批评：“小姐送他衣服，红颜色很稳重，不见得比这些衣服差呢。”

en.t: But the older gentlewomen there criticized this, saying, "The robes the lady sent him were a dignified shade of red; they are not necessarily inferior to these."

units.source_text: 大家又口口声声地说：“讲到诗，小姐送他的也较为理直气壮。

en.t: Everyone also kept saying, "As for the poem, the one the lady sent him was more reasonable and confident.

units.source_text: 他的答诗不过技巧偏胜而已。”

en.t: His reply poem was merely superior in technique, that is all."

units.source_text: 小姐自己也觉得吟成这首诗煞费苦心，因此把它写在一个地方，永远保留。

en.t: The lady herself also felt that composing this poem had taken great effort, so she wrote it down somewhere and kept it forever.
